name: config-defaults
description: Both sides add a config key at the end of the interface and of the defaults; upstream also raises the timeout default on the line next to it. The resolution keeps both keys and the new timeout.

plan.title: Verbose logging flag
plan.intent: Add a verbose flag to the client config, off by default.

plan.title: Configurable base URL, longer timeout
plan.intent: Make the API base URL configurable (default https://api.example.com) and raise the default timeout to 5 seconds after production timeouts.
